codeReview.summary: The fix correctly addresses the phantom template bug. The inactiveTemplates computed property now sources from review.value.templates instead of the global useTemplatesFetch() store. Field mapping from ReviewTemplate shape (templateId, templateName, templateVersion) to display shape (id, name, version, status) is correct. The unused useTemplatesFetch import was cleanly removed. The filter logic correctly excludes the active template by comparing templateId to activeTemplate.value.id. All 602 tests pass and typecheck is clean.

issues.description: Status mapping uses currentReview.status.toUpperCase() for inactive templates. ReviewStatus is 'draft' | 'in-progress' | 'completed' | 'archived', but statusBadgeClass() only handles 'ACTIVE', 'DRAFT', and 'REVIEW' — so 'IN-PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED', and 'ARCHIVED' all hit the default gray style. This is consistent with how activeTemplate already handles status (same pattern on line 216), so it's not a regression from this fix, but is a pre-existing display issue.

No unit test was added for the inactiveTemplates computed property. While the existing 602 tests pass, a targeted test verifying that inactiveTemplates filters from review templates (not global templates) would prevent regression. This is understandable for a small computed property fix but worth noting.
